title: Research Websites and Digital Primary-Source Portals
scope_note: Curated international starter catalogue of scholarly discovery services, digital libraries, archives, historical newspapers, audiovisual and photographic collections, maps, statistics, research repositories, digital-humanities infrastructures and specialist primary-source portals. It prioritises resources with clear research value rather than generic institutional homepages. It is broad but not literally exhaustive.

geography_schema.country: Country when a resource is primarily national.
geography_schema.region: Subnational or transnational region when useful.

field_notes.knowledge_domains: One or more disciplinary or thematic knowledge areas.
field_notes.type_of_use: What a researcher can practically use the site for.
field_notes.provenance: Main curation source used to identify or prioritise the resource.
